dash_sub: Complete low-level inspection of motherboard architecture, SoC, display, and memory.
guide_step1: 1. Go to Settings > About Phone > Tap 'Build Number' 7 times until Developer Mode is unlocked.
guide_step2: 2. Open Settings > Developer Options > Enable 'USB Debugging'.
guide_step3: 3. Connect USB cable, unlock your phone screen, and tap 'Allow' on the prompt.
alert_unauthorized_desc: Device is connected via USB, but you MUST unlock your phone screen and tap 'ALLOW' on the 'Allow USB debugging?' prompt.
alert_offline_desc: Device is connected but unresponsive. Please unplug and re-plug the USB cable, and ensure the phone screen is awake.
alert_pnp_title: Phone Detected on USB, but USB Debugging is DISABLED!
alert_pnp_desc:
Windows detected your device on USB ({names}), but it is only in charging/MTP mode. To diagnose:
1. Go to Settings > About Phone > Tap 'Build Number' 7 times.
2. Go to Settings > Developer Options > Turn ON 'USB Debugging'.
board_title: Battery Fuel Gauge, Charging IC & Thermal Diagnostics
board_sub: Analyzes vendor sysfs kernel nodes, Battery voltage (fuel gauge), battery current, and thermal zone maps.
card_nand_wear: eMMC / UFS CHIP LIFESPAN & WEAR LEVEL
card_leakage: SCREEN-OFF BATTERY CURRENT (wireless ADB, no charger)
hw_sub: Inspect reported sensors, biometric IC, physical keys continuity, SIM reader, camera, and display backlight.
card_audio_codec: Audio codec IC & ALSA sound cards
card_panel_info: Display panel info & verified boot state
card_storage_bench: NAND STORAGE (eMMC/UFS) LIFE CYCLE & SPEED BENCHMARK
malware_sub: Lists third-party apps holding sensitive permissions, enabled accessibility services, device admins, user-installed CA certificates and network connections. This is an inventory for review, not a malware verdict.
opt_sub: Trims app caches (free space measured before/after) and starts Android's own storage-maintenance and app-compilation jobs (their effect cannot be measured). No files are deleted and no settings are changed.
rescue_title: Broken Screen, Fastboot & System Recovery Center
rescue_sub: Launch low-latency scrcpy screen mirroring, inspect setup wizard flags, erase the cache partition, flash images, and rescue user data.
card_partition_backup: Critical partitions & radio backup (EFS / modem / persist)
btn_scrcpy_otg: Launch OTG Mouse/Keyboard Mode (No ADB Required)
desc_scrcpy_otg: Hardware USB HID emulation. Control broken-screen or locked phone using PC mouse & keyboard (Zero ADB required).
reports_sub: Export HTML / printable diagnostic reports with the raw evidence behind every check.
card_logscan: Offline log analysis (UART / dmesg / last_kmsg / logcat)
uart.open_failed: Could not open {port}: {error}. Check that the adapter is plugged in and that no other program (a serial terminal, another capture) is using the port.
uart.read_failed: The capture on {port} stopped: {error}. The adapter was probably unplugged; what was received so far is saved.
uart.size_limit: The capture reached {mb} MB and was stopped to protect the disk.
uart.save_failed: Could not create the capture file {path}: {error}. The port was released; choose a folder you can write to.
display.assess.consistent: Consistent with an original screen: {supports} indicator(s) support it and none is against.
display.assess.against: {against} indicator(s) conflict with an original screen (possible causes, see below).
display.assess.insufficient: Not enough data to assess: this phone does not expose enough about its screen without root.
display.not_proof: Software cannot prove that a screen is original; these are indicators only. An original Samsung service-pack screen fitted later cannot be told apart from the factory one.
display.ind.panel_maker_sdc: Panel {panel}: Samsung Display, the maker of original Samsung screens (read from the panel's own chip).
display.ind.panel_maker_other: Panel {panel} (maker: {maker}). Some original phones use this maker too, so it is not judged.
display.ind.panel_ids_ok: The panel carries its serial numbers (cell ID {cell}).
display.ind.panel_ids_zero: The panel's serial numbers read as all zeros: original panels carry real ones. Possible causes: a non-original panel, or a panel whose ID area was not programmed.
display.ind.panel_date: Panel manufacture date (as decoded by the kernel): {date}.
display.ind.modes: Native resolution {res}, refresh rates {rates} Hz (max {max_hz} Hz), HDR: {hdr}. Compare with the specs the manufacturer publishes for this model.
display.ind.fp_works: The under-display fingerprint sensor has worked: {count} successful unlock(s) recorded (counted since the fingerprints were enrolled). It often stops working with a non-original screen.
display.ind.fp_crash: The under-display fingerprint driver keeps crashing. Possible causes: a non-original screen, a damaged sensor or a disconnected flex.
display.ind.fp_no_record: Under-display fingerprint sensor present, but no successful use is recorded: enrol a fingerprint and try it to use this indicator.
report.log_not_counted: This is the analysis of the log file named above, which may come from another phone: it is not counted in this phone's overall result.
card_display_check: Screen and parts originality indicators (read only)
ui.display_hint: Click 'Screen & Parts Originality Check'. It only reads: panel identity, resolution and refresh rates, the under-display fingerprint sensor, and the camera sensors and fingerprint maker compared with the model's factory firmware. It gives indicators, never proof.
cli.uart_no_ports: No serial port found. Plug in the USB-UART adapter (CH340, CP210x, FTDI or PL2303) and check that its driver is installed.
cli.uart_wiring: Wiring (read only): adapter GND to phone GND, adapter RX to phone TX; leave the adapter's TX unconnected. Many phones use 1.8 V on these pads: a 3.3 V adapter can damage them and may not read them; use an adapter or level shifter for that voltage.
cli.uart_capturing: Capturing {port} at {baud} baud for {seconds} s into {path} (Ctrl+C stops early)...
cli.uart_nothing: Nothing was received. Check the wiring (phone TX to adapter RX, and GND), that the phone is being powered on during the capture, and the baud rate (115200 is usual; some boot stages use 921600).

battery.current_note.wifi: Wireless ADB: no USB charging current included
battery.current_note.usb: Includes charging current while USB is connected
battery.flag.low_voltage_charging: Low battery voltage while charging (< {limit} mV). Possible causes: degraded battery cell, charging circuit fault.
battery.flag.low_charge_current: Low charging current (< {limit} mA) on external power. Possible causes: dirty port, bad cable, weak charger, USB board damage.
battery.reset_stats.result:
dumpsys batterystats --reset -> exit {exit}: {output}
This only clears Android's battery usage history; it does not change the battery or fuel gauge.
leak.not_measured.usb: Not measured: the phone is connected over USB, which supplies current. Connect with wireless ADB, unplug the cable/charger and run the test again.
leak.not_measured.power_unknown: Not measured: could not confirm that no charger is connected (dumpsys battery unreadable).
leak.not_measured.charger: Not measured: a charger or external power source is connected. Unplug it and run the test again.
leak.incomplete_samples: Battery current could not be read for every sample; no average is reported.
leak.power_changed: External power was connected (or could not be ruled out) at the end of the test; result discarded.
leak.high: Screen-off battery current is high: average {avg} mA, peak {peak} mA (limits {avg_limit:g} / {peak_limit:g} mA).
leak.normal: Screen-off battery current: average {avg} mA, peak {peak} mA (below {avg_limit:g} / {peak_limit:g} mA).
leak.cause.wakelocks: Apps or services keeping the phone awake (wakelocks, sync, updates)
leak.cause.radio: Radio activity: weak mobile signal, Wi-Fi / wireless ADB traffic
leak.cause.board: A component drawing current on the board (only after software causes are excluded)
bootreason.uvlo: An under-voltage power loss is recorded.
bootreason.watchdog: A watchdog / kernel panic reset is recorded.
bootreason.normal: The last boot reason '{reason}' does not indicate an abnormal shutdown.
bootreason.not_reported: The boot reason is not reported by this device.
kernellog.errors_found: Kernel / storage errors or abnormal resets were found in the logs (see evidence).
kernellog.clean: Kernel log was read: no panic or storage I/O error lines found.
kernellog.needs_root: The kernel log (dmesg) is blocked without root.
kernellog.unreadable: The kernel log could not be read.
bootrom.none: No emergency BootROM / EDL / recovery USB interface detected on the Windows USB ports.
bootrom.qualcomm_edl: Hypothesis: the device is in Qualcomm Emergency Download mode (EDL 9008).
bootrom.mediatek_brom: Hypothesis: the device is in MediaTek BootROM / Preloader mode.
bootrom.samsung_odin: Hypothesis: the device is in Samsung Download (Odin) mode.
bootrom.usb_cycling: Hypothesis: the device keeps connecting and disconnecting on USB. Observed: {observed}
bootrom.other_port: Hypothesis: a low-level USB interface was detected: {name}.
bootrom.phone_present: No emergency BootROM / EDL port, but the phone is present on USB: {vendor} device, VID {vid}, PID {pid}, serial {serial}. The board is powered and the USB data lines work; this program does not know which mode this PID is.
logscan.found: {count} known fault signature(s) found in the log. The line where the boot most likely stopped: line {line} ({rule}). These are possible causes, not a definite diagnosis.
logscan.no_known_fault: No known fault signature in {lines} line(s). This does not prove the phone is healthy: only the faults in the signature database are recognised.
logscan.mostly_unreadable: {pct}% of the log is unreadable characters (a UART capture at the wrong baud rate looks like this; 115200 is the usual rate). Nothing known was found in the readable part.
bootrom.cause.edl_gpt: Corrupted or unreadable eMMC / UFS partition table (GPT)
bootrom.cause.edl_hardware: Damage or solder fatigue on the storage chip or SoC
bootrom.cause.edl_testpoint: EDL test point or a key line shorted to ground
bootrom.cause.mtk_flash: eMMC / UFS failure or unprogrammed storage
bootrom.cause.mtk_power: Power rails collapsing during early boot
bootrom.cause.mtk_key: Download key line (KCOL0) shorted to ground
bootrom.cause.odin_softbrick: Bootloop / soft brick after an incomplete update
bootrom.cause.odin_lock: A lock (FRP / Knox) forced download mode
bootrom.cause.odin_pit: Faulty partition table (PIT) or bad storage blocks
bootrom.cause.cycling_bootloop: Reset loop: battery voltage drops below the shutdown threshold
bootrom.cause.cycling_usb_lines: Short on VBUS, CC or USB data lines in the charging board / flex
bootrom.cause.cycling_solder: Cracked solder joints under the SoC or power IC
bootrom.cause.vendor_mode: Device in a vendor-specific recovery or factory diagnostic mode
charging.summary: Type: {type} | Protocol: {protocol} | Measured input: {volts} V @ {amps} A = {watts} W | Battery: {level}% ({state})
storage.wear.high: Storage wear registers report high wear (see evidence).
storage.wear.needs_root: Storage health registers are blocked without root.
storage.wear.not_exposed: Storage health registers are not exposed on this device.
storage.cause.endurance: Flash memory near the end of its rated write endurance; back up user data.
bench.unparsed: The write benchmark output could not be parsed. Write = {write} MB/s, read = {read} MB/s.
bench.slow: Write = {write} MB/s is below {limit} MB/s (read = {read} MB/s). Possible causes: worn flash, nearly full storage, thermal throttling, heavy background I/O.
bench.ok: Write = {write} MB/s, read = {read} MB/s (read may be served from the page cache).
stress.progress: [{second}/{total}s] CPU avg: {freq} MHz | Voltage: {volts} mV | Temp: {temp}°C
stress.no_data: No CPU frequency or battery voltage could be read during the test.
stress.sag: Battery voltage dropped {sag} mV under load. Possible causes: worn battery (high internal resistance), poor battery contact.
stress.no_voltage: Battery voltage under load could not be measured; only CPU frequencies were read.
stress.freq_range: CPU frequency varied from {max} to {min} MHz (throttling or normal frequency scaling).
forensics.no_root: Root (su) is not available; kernel log and raw register forensics need root.
forensics.finding.i2c: {count} I2C error lines in the kernel log
forensics.finding.storage: Storage wear registers report high wear
forensics.findings: Findings (possible causes, not a definitive diagnosis): {items}
forensics.clean: Kernel logs were read with {root_type}: no matching fault signatures or I2C errors.
forensics.no_logs: Root is available but no kernel log could be read.
efs.needs_root: Root access is required to copy raw radio partitions.
efs.progress.scanning: Root verified ({root_type}). Looking for EFS / NVRAM partitions...
efs.no_by_name: Could not find the partition by-name directory on the device.
efs.none_matched: No radio / EFS partitions found (efs, modemst1, modemst2, persist, nvram).
camera.count_only: Count reported; per-camera details not parsed
fp.hw_unavailable: The fingerprint service reports the hardware as unavailable.
fp.service_missing: The device declares a fingerprint sensor but the fingerprint service is not running.
fp.hal_crash_loop: The fingerprint driver ({process}) crashed {count} times in Android's crash log ({signal}). The sensor cannot work while its driver keeps crashing, even though the service still lists it.
fp.reported: The fingerprint sensor is reported by the fingerprint service. A touch / enrolment test is still needed to confirm it works.
fp.not_declared: The device does not declare a fingerprint sensor.
fp.unknown: The fingerprint sensor state could not be determined from the service output.
fp.cause.flex: Disconnected or damaged fingerprint flex cable
keys.state.DOWN_NO_UP: Pressed, not released before the capture ended
keys.tested: Keys pressed and released during the capture: {keys}.
keys.cause.stuck: Pressed but not released before the capture ended: {keys} (stuck key, or still held)
keys.permission: getevent could not open the input devices (permission denied).
keys.no_events: No key events captured. Press Vol+, Vol- and Power during the {seconds}s capture. Error: {error}
keys.not_run: Key test not run (interactive: run it from the keys card).
sim.no_telephony: The device does not declare telephony (Wi-Fi only); SIM / baseband not applicable.
sim.no_baseband: Telephony is declared and the radio reports a SIM state, but no baseband version is reported.
sim.ready: SIM reported READY / LOADED (carrier: {carrier}, network: {network}, baseband: {baseband}).
sim.absent: No SIM inserted: the SIM reader cannot be tested without a card.
sim.inconclusive: SIM state '{state}' does not allow a conclusion (e.g. airplane mode or PIN lock).
sim.not_reported: The SIM state is not reported.
sim.cause.modem_fw: Modem firmware not loaded / corrupted modem partition
sim.cause.tray: Dirty or bent SIM tray contacts
wifi.hal_failure: The Wi-Fi framework reports a vendor HAL / driver start failure.
wifi.disabled: Wi-Fi is turned off; turn it on to test the adapter.
wifi.unreadable: The Wi-Fi state could not be read.
wifi.cause.chip: Wi-Fi chip not powered or damaged
bt.not_declared: The device does not declare Bluetooth.
bt.service_missing: Bluetooth is declared but the Bluetooth manager service is not running.
bt.off: Bluetooth is turned off; turn it on to test the adapter.
bt.unreadable: The Bluetooth state could not be read.
features.summary: Declared by the system (not hardware-tested) - GPS: {gps} | NFC: {nfc} | USB host / OTG: {otg}
display.dsi_errors: The kernel log contains display panel probe / DSI errors.
display.cause.flex: Loose or damaged display flex connector
display.brightness_zero: Backlight brightness is 0 (screen off?). Turn the screen on and try again.
display.brightness_unreadable: Backlight brightness could not be read.
audio.service_missing: The audio service (media.audio_flinger) is not running.
audio.ok: {cards} sound card(s) and {threads} open output thread(s) reported.
audio.ok_cards_unread: The audio service reports {threads} open output thread(s); the sound card list was not read ({status}).
audio.unreadable: The audio subsystem state could not be read.
audio.cause.codec_boot: Audio codec not detected at boot
audio.cause.codec_kernel: Audio codec not detected by the kernel
panel.needs_root: The kernel log (dmesg) is blocked without root; the panel controller name is not available.
panel.not_exposed: The display controller name is not exposed in the kernel log or sysfs.
companion.install_user_restricted: The phone refused to install the companion app ({output}). On Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO turn on "Install via USB" in Developer options (it may ask for a Mi account and a SIM card); on other phones accept the install prompt on the screen. Then run the test again.
companion.using_installed: The phone did not accept the install ({reason}), so the companion app already on the phone (version {version}) was used.
companion.using_installed_other_version: The phone did not accept the install ({reason}), so the companion app already on the phone was used: version {version} (code {code}), not the one shipped with this program (code {expected}). Results come from that copy; tests it does not have are missing.
companion.install_other_key: The companion app on the phone was built with another key (installed from another PC), so it was not replaced ({output}). It is never uninstalled automatically. To install this program's version, uninstall the companion app on the phone, then run the test again.
companion.using_installed_other_key: The companion app on the phone was built with another key (installed from another PC), so it was not replaced and that copy (version {version}) was used ({reason}). To install this program's version, uninstall the companion app on the phone, then run the test again.
companion.permission_denied: Not tested: the phone did not give the companion app the {permission} permission. Tap Allow when the app asks, or enable it in the app's settings.
colortest.started: Colour test opened on the phone. Tap the screen to switch colours.
colortest.failed: Could not open the colour test: {error}
colortest.stopped: Colour test closed and touch overlays turned off.
tone.playing: Playing a {freq} Hz test tone on the loudspeaker.
hw.summary.pass: PASS: all key hardware checks passed
storagehealth.high: Wear registers report high wear (up to {pct}% of rated life, pre-EOL: {eol}). Possible cause: flash near the end of its endurance; back up the data.
storagehealth.ok: Wear registers read: up to {pct}% of rated life used, pre-EOL: {eol}.
storagehealth.needs_root: Wear registers for {type} are blocked without root.
storagehealth.not_exposed: Wear registers are not exposed (or unreadable) on this {type} device.
storagehealth.bench_unparsed: Benchmark: dd output could not be parsed.
storagehealth.bench_result: Benchmark: write {write} MB/s, read {read} MB/s (read may be served from the page cache).
maint.progress.step3: Step 3/3: cmd package bg-dexopt-job (not measurable, may take minutes)...
maint.progress.done: Done. Measured change in free storage after the cache trim: {delta} MB.
maint.note.trim_failed: The command failed; no space change is attributed to it.
maint.note.trim_measured: Change in free /data space measured around the command (other apps writing at the same time also affect it).
maint.note.trim_unmeasured: The command ran but free space could not be read before and after.
maint.note.idle_maint: Requests Android's storage maintenance job. Its effect is not measurable here.
maint.note.dexopt: Runs Android's background app compilation job now. Its effect is not measurable here.
ca.needs_root: The user CA certificate store cannot be read without root.
ca.not_found: The user CA certificate store directory was not found.
ca.unlisted: The user CA certificate store could not be listed.

sec.progress.ca: Reading the user CA certificate store...
sec.note.accessibility: Accessibility service enabled: it can read the screen and act on the user's behalf.

sec.note.no_launcher: No launcher icon (normal for many helper / companion apps).
sec.summary: {apps} of {total} third-party apps hold sensitive permissions or special access. User CA certificates: {ca}.

backup.contacts_blocked: Contacts: not readable (needs permission or the contacts provider is restricted)
port.edl: The phone is in Qualcomm Emergency Download mode (EDL 9008). Possible causes: corrupted boot partitions, damaged storage chip, or a forced test point.
port.qcom_900e: The phone is in Qualcomm diagnostic mode 900E (boot stopped before the kernel).

ui.companion_wifi_steps:
1. Scan the code and open the page.
2. Download the app and install it (once per phone).
3. Tap "Start the test" on the page, then Start in the app.
4. Keep the phone still on a table. The results appear here.

If Windows asks, allow the program on private networks.

parts.ind.no_reference: No reference for this phone (model {model}, codename {codename}) among the {count} models in the parts database: the parts are listed but not compared.

parts.ind.sensor_listed: Camera sensor {sensor} is one the factory firmware of {name} supports (module makers: {modules}).
parts.ind.sensor_platform: Camera sensor {sensor} is known only from sibling models of the same platform: shown, not judged.
parts.ind.sensor_not_listed: Camera sensor {sensor} is not among the sensors the factory firmware of {name} supports ({expected}). Possible causes: a replaced camera module, or a production variant not in the reference list.
parts.ind.fp_no_reference: Fingerprint maker reported by the phone: {maker}. No reference for this model.
parts.ind.fp_listed: Fingerprint maker {maker} is one the firmware of {name} is built for.
parts.ind.fp_not_listed: Fingerprint maker {maker} is not among those the firmware of {name} is built for ({expected}). Possible causes: a replaced fingerprint sensor, or a variant not in the reference list.
parts.ind.fp_platform: Fingerprint maker {maker}; the reference ({expected}) comes from a firmware tree shared with sibling models: shown, not judged.
parts.assess.consistent: Consistent with original parts ({supports} supporting indicators, none against).
parts.assess.against: {against} indicator(s) conflict with original parts (possible causes, see below).
parts.assess.insufficient: Not enough readings to assess the parts ({supports} supporting indicator(s)).
parts.not_proof: Software cannot prove that a part is original; these are indicators only. Reference: LineageOS device wiki and firmware file lists. A high-quality copy that reports the original part's name cannot be told apart.
